title: Extended Monitoring with Verification and Guardrails
overview:
Add optional integrations for verification monitoring and guardrails monitoring to support mode, making it work with various test runners and quality gates.

**Motivation:** Provides comprehensive monitoring beyond basic state tracking, enabling teams to catch test failures and guardrail violations early

**Success criteria:**
- VerificationMonitor supports multiple backends (pytest, custom, manual)
- GuardrailMonitor loads and reports guardrails from .aprd/guardrails.json
- Supports multiple tracker formats (.aprd/tracker.json, .taskmaster/tracker.json, tasks.json)

**Technical constraints:**
- Make verification and guardrails monitoring optional/pluggable
- Support multiple verification backends
- Create framework-agnostic task tracking support

**In scope:**
- Verification monitoring with pytest/custom test runners
- Guardrails monitoring from .aprd/guardrails.json
- Multiple tracker format support
**Out of scope:**
- Breaking changes to existing verification systems

**Signals:** priority: medium
